notes:
Checked on 2026-10-10. Read the entire 74838-character markdown, including references and all appendices, and checked relevant PDF text with PyMuPDF. The source contains 24 pages (printed pp. 70-93). Exact quoted wording was taken from the PDF text; line breaks and layout whitespace are normalized. Statements record the scale provenance, in-paper prompts, and appendix references/captions; none is a promise to share raw data.

No data-availability or data-on-request statement, public data/code repository, preregistration link, or separate supplementary-file link is stated. The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty. SPSS is named as analysis software (PDF p. 13, printed p. 82), but no SPSS data file, syntax, or other analysis code is supplied.

The publisher's openly accessible article PDF contains Table 3's writing prompts, aggregate results, and illustrative appendices. Visual inspection of Ek 1-3 (PDF pp. 22-24, printed pp. 91-93) confirmed four student-writing examples from intervention weeks, three labeled as post-test examples, and four ChatGPT text examples. These are embedded images, not a participant-level dataset: no arm labels or linked outcome scores are supplied for these examples, and there is no participant-ID key linking them to the analyzed sample or across measurement times. The example counts are image counts, not verified numbers of unique participants. The PDF has no embedded file attachments. The article and its illustrative appendices are not counted as separate research-data deposits; this is the basis for status none_found rather than public_partial.

No relevant deposit was identified in DataCite, Zenodo, Harvard Dataverse or OSF. The same-author Zenodo hit is an unrelated 2024 article and is excluded from deposits. All required title/author searches completed, after correcting Zenodo's unauthenticated page-size limit. No account, access request, authentication or bot-check bypass was used. The conclusion is limited to the sources and queries checked, rather than proof that an unindexed deposit cannot exist.

No public participant-level data were available to resolve S1's excluded-versus-analyzed pupil counts or the control post-test SD/paired-test degrees-of-freedom discrepancies in final.open_items. The illustrative texts do not establish the administered test prompt or test-time AI availability, and do not support arm-level diversity estimates for the analyzed sample. No missing statistic was computed or guessed; what_we_could_compute is null. One randomized class per arm remains a design limitation even if individual data later become available.
